english: Consider the five observations $1,2,8,10,14$. Two of these observations are replaced by two integers $x$ and $y$ with $x<y$, in such a way that the mean of the five observations is unchanged and their standard deviation becomes twice the original standard deviation. Then the value of $x$ is ______.
hindi: पाँच प्रेक्षणों $1,2,8,10,14$ पर विचार कीजिए। इनमें से दो प्रेक्षणों को दो पूर्णांकों $x$ तथा $y$, जहाँ $x<y$ है, से इस प्रकार प्रतिस्थापित किया जाता है कि पाँचों प्रेक्षणों का माध्य अपरिवर्तित रहता है तथा उनका मानक विचलन मूल मानक विचलन का दुगुना हो जाता है। तब $x$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Replace $p,q$ by $x,y$: $x+y=p+q$; new $\sigma^2=96\Rightarrow\sum$ of squares rises by $5(96-24)=360$: $x^2+y^2=p^2+q^2+360$
solution_full: Let $p,q$ be the replaced observations. The mean is unchanged, so $x+y=p+q$.
With the same mean, $5\sigma^2=\sum x_i^2-5\cdot49$. The new variance is $4\cdot24=96$, so the sum of squares increases by $5(96-24)=360$: $x^2+y^2=p^2+q^2+360$.

For integers $x,y$, $(p-q)^2+720$ must be a perfect square. The possible $|p-q|$ are $1,7,9,13,6,8,12,2,6,4$; the values $(p-q)^2+720$ are $721,769,801,889,756,784,864,724,756,736$, and only $784=28^2$ is a square, for $\{p,q\}=\{2,10\}$.
Check: $1,8,14,-8,20$ have mean $7$ and $\sum(x_i-7)^2=36+1+49+225+169=480$, variance $96$, standard deviation $4\sqrt6=2\cdot2\sqrt6$.
originality_note: New: two unknown observations replace an unknown pair while the mean is kept and the SD doubled; the identity (y - x)^2 = (p - q)^2 + 720 turns the choice of pair into a perfect-square test (way 4: a hidden invariant). Closest known: 'mean and variance given, three of five observations known; find the other two'. Different because: which two observations are replaced is not told, and integrality selects the pair.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked all 10 pairs by brute force: only (2,10) works, giving x = -8, y = 20. Changed: No change.
key_step: Reducing the two conditions to (y - x)^2 = (p - q)^2 + 720 and testing the pairwise differences.
justification: Same demand as 2026-P2-Q12 (L2: recover observations from mean and variance) plus an extra idea: the replaced pair is unknown and found by a perfect-square test. One level higher, Level 3.

concept_use.Analysis of frequency distributions with: The new data set has the same mean 7 but four times the variance; the equal mean gives x + y = p + q.
concept_use.Standard deviation and variance of ungro: Variance 24 of the data and the sum of squares rising by 360 for variance 96.
